itemized.notes: THIS PDF IS A FAX BUNDLE OF TWO DIFFERENT FORMS, and one fax page is missing from our copy. The fax header numbers the transmission 'Page N of 7' but the PDF holds only 6 pages: fax pages 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. FAX PAGE 2 IS ABSENT. PDF p1 is a 'Statement of Organization For a Candidate' (committee/secretary registration, NOT the disclosure cover), and fax page 2 is almost certainly its continuation - the Financial Disclosure Report itself is internally numbered 'Page 1 of 5' .. 'Page 5 of 5' and ALL FIVE of its pages are present (PDF p2 Summary, p3 Schedule A, p4-p6 Schedule B). So no money page is missing; the gap is in the registration form. Recorded because the chunk file's page count (6) and the fax's own count (7) disagree. THE CHUNK FILE'S report_type IS EMPTY and the document supports that: PDF p1 is a Statement of Organization with no 'Type of Report' box at all, and the Summary Page carries no checked box either - only the Date of Report 4/6/2014. Do not infer a period from the filename 'StoutC_2014_April'. PRIVACY: the county redacted the Complete Mailing Address column on p3 with a solid black bar over every filled row; donor_city/donor_state blank, 'redacted' stated per row. One aggregate row ('Contributions of $50 and unde...') runs under the redaction bar and is left incomplete.
